Six weeks,
zero fluff.
Two live calls a week, homework that is actually your business, and a community that reviews your outreach before your prospects do.
Stop selling hours. We carve one productized offer out of what you already do well.
A number your landlord would respect. Anchoring, packaging, and saying it out loud without flinching.
Outreach scripts that sound like you, a pipeline in a spreadsheet, and the follow-up cadence that isn't stalking.
Onboarding, scope walls, and the Tuesday-only meeting policy. Keep the margin you just created.
Tuesday teardown, Friday office hours. Both recorded, neither optional the first time.
No fake case studies. The offer you write in week 1 is the one you sell in week 5.
Forty people, one channel, moderated hard. Wins posted with numbers or not at all.
You freelance full-time · you have at least three past clients · you can give it five hours a week · you are tired of proposals.
You want passive income · you haven't done the work yet · you collect courses · you need permission, not a system.
Finish the six weeks. No pipeline? Full refund.
Show your homework, get your money back. Four people have asked in eleven cohorts.

meta_description: Six weeks, zero fluff: find the offer, price it like rent, sell without cringe, deliver on rails.
